notes:
What's new

- Fixed the toolbar not coming back when you click: on videos the player's own video window was swallowing clicks, so the controls could stay hidden forever. A transparent input layer over the video now catches them, and images and audio use the same, more reliable show/hide rule.
- The toolbar no longer gets stuck in a hidden state after auto-hide; clicking always brings it back, and clicking again hides it as expected.
- CI now reports the exact generated fixture that fails (build annotations) and uses the reader path for HTML, so the public matrix is deterministic.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.30 - toolbar show/hide fix. Root cause: media clicks relied on the WinPreview video child, but VLC creates its own 'VLC video output' child (and some builds replace/subclass the surface), which swallowed every click; the media canvas path also evaluated m_guiVisible after WakeAllUiAndCursor had already set it. Added a 1/255-alpha layered input overlay over the video that forwards move/click/double-click/right-click/wheel, and unified every canvas toggle on the actual dock target opacity (HandleCanvasChromeClick). tests/chrome_toggle_test.py (38 checks) covers image, audio and video show/hide cycles, overlay geometry and the surface fallback, and runs in production_check. CI matrix now prints GitHub annotations per failure and disables WebView2 for determinism.
